description: Look up DNS records for a domain via Cloudflare DNS-over-HTTPS. Returns A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME, and SOA records. Use to see where a domain is hosted, who runs its mail and DNS, and what verification/policy TXT records it publishes.

types.description: Optional subset of record types, e.g. ["MX","TXT"]. Defaults to all common types.

name: dns_lookup
title: DNS Lookup
